observations: Jewelry homepage uses a statement-gold campaign hero, first-order offer, jewelry-category navigation, shop-collections shelf, product collections, markdown promotion, New Arrivals and Best Sellers shelves.

Editorial story sections include shoppable-look hotspots, after-image slider, London store/appointment copy, journal, brand story, craftsmanship and sustainability messaging; footer exposes collection, care and newsletter routes.
Demo copy identifies YSSO as the provider of product content and imagery; certification, sustainability and store claims are unverified.
All Jewelry shows 120 results, Best selling sort, and Availability, Price, Ring size, Style and Color filter groups.
Cards display products, prices and new badges. No filters, sorting or card controls were activated.

Batis Ring PDP shows $352, a ring-size selector from 0.5 to 13, size guide, in-stock copy, Add to Bag and Buy It Now controls, related product Quick View controls, materials/care and shipping sections.
No variant, quantity, Quick View, accordion, cart or purchase action was used; price, stock, material, import-duty and sustainability claims remain unverified.
Dedicated cart says YOUR CART IS EMPTY and There are no items in your cart; Continue Shopping and collection/newsletter footer links are visible.

caveats: No filters, sort, Quick View, ring-size, cart mutation or checkout interactions.
No screenshot, measured viewport/mobile, Theme Editor, keyboard or performance tests.
Demo product, stock, sourcing, sustainability, shipping and store claims are unverified.
